title: Evaluation on a Supported Coordinate Set
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $F$ assign a real coefficient to every subset of $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, and let $X_j:\Omega\to\bbr$ be real-valued functions. For a subset $s$ of the coordinate set, suppose $F(T)=0$ whenever $T$ is not contained in $s$. Then, for every $\omega\in\Omega$, the multilinear evaluation $\sum_{T\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}}F(T)\prod_{j\in T}X_j(\omega)$ equals $\sum_{T\subseteq s}F(T)\prod_{j\in T}X_j(\omega)$.
hypotheses_covered: $F$ is a real coefficient family on subsets of the $n$-coordinate set
$s$ is a subset of the coordinate set
replaced: Let $F$ be a real coefficient family indexed by subsets of $[n]$, let $X_i:\Omega\to\bbr$, and let $s\subseteq[n]$. If $F(T)=0$ whenever $T\nsubseteq s$, then for every $\omega$, $\sum_{T\subseteq[n]}F(T)\prod_{j\in T}X_j(\omega)=\sum_{T\subseteq s}F(T)\prod_{j\in T}X_j(\omega)$.
